aiDataSharing.label: AI data sharing
aiDataSharing.description: What you type or say goes to Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI for processing. Apple or Google speech recognition may turn speech into text. Audio files don't go to Aido's servers.
aiDataSharing.descriptionGoogleOnly: Sends what you type to Google Gemini to organize it into to-dos
aiDataSharing.withdrawDescription: AI features will stop working. Your to-dos stay.
aiDataSharing.declinedStatus: Off. Turn it on to use it again.
aiDataSharing.undecidedStatus: We'll ask the first time you use an AI feature.

voiceStorage.description: Audio files aren't sent to Aido's servers. Voice notes and their audio are deleted automatically after 30 days.
voiceStorage.removeDescription: The text and summary stay. Only the audio is deleted, so you can't play it back. This can't be undone.
